hypotheses.claim: The idempotency middleware in idempotency_key.go (lines 103-112) SHORT-CIRCUITS and calls handlerFunction directly when the X-Payout-Idempotency-Key header is EMPTY and IKeyAutoEnforcement is off/experiment not enabled — meaning it skips the distributed mutex AND the idempotency_keys table dedup entirely. Additionally, business-logic duplicate-prevention (SHA-256 hash, 'for_duplicate_payout_evaluate') is Splitz-gated.
